title: Skirmish at Bender
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Skirmish at Bender", at revision 1378400908, opens: "The Skirmish at Bender was devised to remove Charles XII of Sweden from the Ottoman Empire after his military defeats in Russia. It took place on 1 February 1713 (O.S.) or 12 February 1713 (N.S.) on Ottoman territory, in what is now the town of Bender, Moldova." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q638601, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1713 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
